cohort: 1208 full-term newborn infants at a tertiary eye hospital (Cipto Mangunkusumo National Referral Hospital) and a district hospital in Jakarta (Koja Hospital)
finding: Universal eye screening in healthy neonates is beneficial in the early diagnosis, monitoring and treatment of ocular abnormalities, with retinal hemorrhage being the most common abnormality and associated with delivery method and duration of labor.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was found to be protective against retinal hemorrhage, while prolonged labor increased the risk.
